# Upstream shared instance

[`metrics.lecoq.io`](https://metrics.lecoq.io) is an optional service operated by the upstream project, [lowlighter/metrics](https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics). It is not operated, deployed, or supported by `ddarkr/github-readme-metrics`.

If you choose to use it, review its behavior and availability with upstream and embed the URL it provides in your profile README. Do not send this fork's secrets, tokens, settings files, or private configuration to a third-party endpoint.

For this maintained fork, use the [GitHub Action](/.github/readme/partials/documentation/setup/action.md), [local development](/.github/readme/partials/documentation/setup/local.md), or an operator-controlled [self-hosted instance](/.github/readme/partials/documentation/setup/web.md) instead.
